en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing an ornate historic interior, likely a throne or council room. The room has richly carved wooden wall paneling and furniture (a central table and high-backed chairs). Above the paneling are painted or frescoed full-length portraits of four medieval-looking rulers or knights, each framed in its own Gothic arch. The wallpaper or wall decoration features repeating heraldic motifs and small crosses, and the parquet floor is geometrically patterned.
